summary: Some keys returned by modules are for internal use and are consumed by Ansible, so they are removed from registered variables.
questions: Why are some keys a module returns missing from my registered variable?

answer_card.title: Internal-use return keys
answer_card.answer_md: Some return keys are **consumed by Ansible** (for example `ansible_facts`, `exception`, `deprecations`, `warnings`) and are removed from or handled outside the registered variable.
